findings.detail: Eight earlier-period equity facts were retained in the March 31, 2026 holdings population even though matching current-schedule rows exist.

rationale: The raw filing contains the March 31, 2026 investment schedule in tables 4-7 and the earlier comparative schedule in tables 11-14. The flagged TCW ND Parent, Tabhi Class B, AGY Classes A/B/C, and Encompass Class A lines occur in the earlier schedule (for example tables 13-14) and also have matching lines in the current schedule (tables 6-7). The flagged records are therefore extra comparative-period copies, not distinct March 31, 2026 positions. Two additional flagged rows identified in the bundle have the same earlier-period provenance and mechanism.
